status: completed cached scientific diagnostic; not CF1 efficacy
method: Align to last-observed protein; heavy-atom ligand centroid translation, best proper Kabsch rotation of successive centered ligand shapes, and remaining internal shape residual. Include observed-to-first-future step. Compute per-path step RMS then average draws, anchors and systems. Rotation and residual squared norms have a cross term; not additive fractions.

new48_model_minus_MD.convention: Arrays [mean, paired95percent system-bootstrap lower, upper]; signed amplitude bias, not lower-is-better score.48 system clusters,96 conditions. Exploratory marginal intervals without multiplicity correction.

new48_joint_pattern.definition: Within one condition: model draw-mean translation and rotation RMS below its MD path, internal residual RMS above MD. Descriptive occurrence, not a significance test or distributional defect probability.

interpretation: Both placement-parent seeds have supported collective translation and rotation amplitude deficits on new48. PVB also has these deficits; reference imitation is not the scientific endpoint.

Average internal residual is higher but its paired interval crosses zero for all three models. Do not call this a significant overall internal-deformation excess. Earlier bond-fluctuation findings concern a different observable.
Rigid-fit residual includes legitimate torsion/shape changes, not just unphysical bond jitter. Low residual is not intrinsically good.

Mechanistic motivation for rotation-aware cooperative representations, not proof that mean pooling causes the observed failures. A pure centered rigid rotational vector field averages to zero, but other atom/scalar features can still encode rotation.

Potential follow-up: retain position-feature moments or geometric pair information and test shared translation/rotation plus unconstrained internal residual. Bridge velocity/drift are generative flow/SDE quantities, not directly MD physical velocity/angular velocity.
Do not alter ongoing CF1 or queue an untested alternative before its matched final results. Use this same cached diagnostic on completed CF1/control panels.

One short MD future per condition, reused development systems and fixed atom mapping do not prove equilibrium, kinetics or independent generalization. All near-rank1 fractions were zero in this analyzed panel.
